summary: First-run end-to-end testing of ISO-8583 Lab. Backend pytest 16/16 PASSED (auth, specs, ISO preview/send, logs, templates, stats, billing checkout, free-tier 402 quota, free vs pro stats). Frontend Playwright validated: landing, admin login, dashboard KPIs/charts/recent feed, /app/builder bitmap toggling + DE inputs + preview + send transaction + save template, /app/logs split-pane detail, /app/templates render, /app/pricing (admin sees pro_active, free user sees upgrade button), register flow with auto-login, Stripe upgrade redirect lands on real https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... URL. Auth uses bcrypt $2b$ hashes (verified via working login), httpOnly access_token + refresh_token cookies set on login/register.

minor.issue: Returns 502 'Unable to reach Stripe' immediately after a freshly created checkout session via emergent test key sk_test_emergent. Checkout creation itself succeeds and the URL is a real checkout.stripe.com link. Likely the emergent test key cannot be used to retrieve session status, OR Stripe needs a few seconds to register the session. /billing/return polling page may fail in production preview.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render before data loads – visual is fine but console is noisy. Add minHeight to ResponsiveContainer wrappers.

action_items: Investigate /api/billing/status/{id} 502 with emergent test stripe key – the /billing/return page polls this endpoint, so users completing payment may see an error. If the emergent test key truly does not support get_checkout_status, fall back to webhook-only + treat 502 as 'pending'.
Suppress Recharts width/height warnings by setting explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer wrappers in Dashboard.jsx.
Replace deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') in /app/backend/server.py with FastAPI lifespan context manager (low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: iso8583.py simulate_response (line 331): MTI response calc uses decimal +10 on the last 2 digits – works for 0200→0210 but breaks for MTIs whose last two digits are >=90 (e.g. 0290 would yield 02100). Use int(...)+0x10 with proper modulo if you intend the nibble convention, or document the simplified rule.
server.py uses Mongo-side update on login_attempts but never decays counts beyond the 15-min window check; old rows remain forever – add TTL index on last_attempt or cleanup task.
server.py CORS allow_origins includes both FRONTEND_URL and localhost:3000 explicitly with allow_credentials=True – good; do not introduce '*' here.
Builder.jsx + Logs.jsx use react-resizable-panels with no min-size constraints – fine but consider clamping.
Backend log model lacks indexes on (user_id, status_code) and (user_id, direction) which the /api/logs filter and /api/stats heavily query – will be slow at scale.
test_credentials: admin@iso8583.dev / admin12345 (works). Several TEST_*@example.com free users created during run (one filled with 50+ tx logs to validate quota).
seed_data_creation: Test user TEST_<uuid>@example.com is created and pushed to 50 logs to validate 402 quota. Several additional TEST_ templates and tx logs persist on admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable. The free-user quota test creates 50+ logs on a fresh user; ensure cleanup if you re-run many times to avoid Mongo bloat. Stripe billing/status returns 502 with the test key – treat as known and either skip or accept 200/502.
rca of the issue: /api/billing/status/{id} 502: server.py wraps stripe.get_checkout_status in try/except and re-raises as 502; the underlying StripeCheckout call against sk_test_emergent likely fails because emergentintegrations test-mode shim only supports session creation, not status retrieval. Mitigation: fall back to returning {payment_status:'pending', status:'open'} when the call raises, or rely on the webhook handler to upgrade users.
